items.exampleEn: Her children bring her great joy.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們帶給她很大的快樂。

items.exampleEn: I like to relax at home on Sundays.
items.exampleZh: 我星期天喜歡在家放鬆。

items.exampleEn: She feels confident about her English.
items.exampleZh: 她對自己的英文很有信心。

items.exampleEn: Children have a lot of imagination.
My grandfather is a man of great wisdom.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺是個很有智慧的人。

items.exampleEn: It's hard to satisfy every customer.
items.exampleZh: 要讓每位客人都滿意很難。

items.exampleEn: Thank you. Your advice was very helpful.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝，你的建議很有幫助。
她的演講讓我印象深刻。

items.sentenceEn: Let's relax and watch a movie.
items.sentenceZh: 我們放鬆一下，看部電影吧。

items.audioEn: The people at this hotel are very helpful.
items.audioZh: 這家旅館的人非常樂於幫忙。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得旅館的人怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: I want to be more confident.

items.sentenceZh: 她的畫展現出豐富的想像力。

items.stemEn: I was ____ by his English. It was very good.
items.stemZh: 他的英文讓我印象深刻，說得非常好。

items.stemEn: After a long day at work, I like to ____ in a hot bath.
items.stemZh: 上了一整天班之後，我喜歡泡個熱水澡放鬆一下。

items.passageEn: My grandmother is eighty, but she is still full of joy. Every morning, she relaxes in her garden with a cup of tea. She has great wisdom, and her advice is always helpful. She also has a wonderful imagination and tells my children great stories. "Simple things satisfy me," she often says. She really impresses me.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶八十歲了，但還是充滿喜悅。每天早上，她都在花園裡喝杯茶放鬆一下。她很有智慧，給的建議總是很有幫助。她也很有想像力，會講很棒的故事給我的孩子們聽。她常說：「簡單的事物就能讓我滿足。」她真的讓我很佩服。

options: 簡單的事物就能讓她滿足
她很想念以前上班的日子

referenceEn: This book is very helpful to me.
This book was very helpful for me.
rubricZh: 「很有幫助」可寫例如 very helpful、really helpful；寫 helped me a lot 也正確
用 relax 表示「放輕鬆」，祈使句用原形動詞（例如 relax、just relax 等）
「別擔心」可寫，例如 don't worry 等
